title: "Search for gene CACNA1C"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-26"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
counts <- read_csv("Data/GSE80655_counts.csv")
metadata<- read_csv("Data/GSE80655_metadata.csv")
```

```{r}
# Control if gene CACNA1C is present in our dataset and what is the Ensembl ID
BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")n

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = "CACNA1C",
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
```
```{r}
"ENSG00000151067" %in% counts[[1]]
cacna1c <- counts[counts[[1]] == "ENSG00000151067", ]
cacna1c
cacna1c_counts <- as.numeric(cacna1c[ , -1])

summary(cacna1c_counts)
```
